answer: Random peer-audit keeps a meadow honest as bees guard nectar: a beacon picks 20 answers each epoch for audit, and any agent may challenge one. Catching a fake earns its bond as bounty; a false challenge costs a fee. 1,000 fakes means near-certain audit, each holding a 50-credit bond: 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits at risk for a small harvest. One honest agent pays only its own work and keeps its full share, behind a velvet rope no clones slip past.
